A man in a dark jacket aims and fires a handgun; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the barrel.
A bright, sudden flash and expanding fireball erupts inside a room, consistent with an explosive detonation (e.g., from a grenade or incendiary device).
Multiple visible bullet tracers or impacts streak across a window as gunfire occurs from outside or through the window; sparks and smoke accompany the impacts.
Two men are engaged in close physical combat on the floor: one is on top of the other, applying force in a struggle.
A man lies on the ground while another figure looms over him holding a baby; the prone man appears helpless and distressed, suggesting a coercive or threatening situation.
A bald man in black aims a handgun forward; the gun is clearly held in a firing stance with both hands, and the scene suggests active engagement.
Bald man in black leather jacket fires a handgun; muzzle flash and recoil visible.
Man with dark hair raises and aims a handgun, then fires; gun is clearly pointed and discharged.
Bald man fires again from behind cover; visible muzzle flash and head recoil of target (implied hit).
Man with dark hair fires handgun at close range; muzzle flash and smoke visible in frame f12.
Man with dark hair fires again; clear muzzle flash and smoke plume in frame f14.
Man with dark hair points gun while another figure is seen recoiling/being struck behind him; simultaneous physical engagement implied by proximity and motion blur in f15.
A bright muzzle flash and sparks erupt from the end of a conveyor belt, indicating a firearm discharge at the far end of the belt (likely off-screen shooter or weapon placed there).

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one (blond) is seen lunging/attacking (f1), while the other (dark hair) reacts aggressively (f2–f3), culminating in the blond man being thrown onto the conveyor belt (f4).
The dark-haired man lies prone on the conveyor belt and fires a handgun directly toward the camera; visible muzzle flash and recoil confirm active shooting.
The blond man, now standing, aims and fires a handgun toward the dark-haired man (off-screen); his posture and weapon orientation indicate active discharge.
The dark-haired man slides along the conveyor belt while firing a handgun; sparks are visible near the belt surface, consistent with muzzle flash or impact, supporting active shooting during motion.
A handgun is fired, producing a bright muzzle flash and smoke plume visible in close-up.

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one man (in black jacket) grabs and subdues another man who is on the ground; the aggressor appears to be striking or restraining him while both are surrounded by filing cabinets.
A man stands over a prone, motionless person on the floor, holding a gun aloft in a dominant posture; the victim shows no resistance, indicating helplessness.
A man fires a handgun, with visible muzzle flash and bullet trajectory in the air; another shooter is simultaneously firing on the right.
A man lifts and swings a metal table frame as a weapon toward an opponent lying on the ground, indicating active physical combat.
A man aims and fires a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle flash is not visible but the gun is clearly discharged (implied by posture, recoil, and context of prior shots).
A person lies motionless on the floor under a table while another figure looms over them; the prone individual appears helpless and possibly incapacitated, consistent with post-assault state.
A person fires a firearm from an elevated position, producing a visible muzzle flash and smoke plume.
Multiple individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat on a staircase; one is thrown over the railing, others grapple and fall amid debris.
A man in a dark coat fires a handgun downward from a staircase; a bright muzzle flash and smoke plume are visible at the barrel.
The same man fires again from the staircase, producing a clear muzzle flash and smoke cloud to his left (viewer's right).
A third shot is fired by the man while moving down the stairs; a muzzle flash is visible near the railing.
Multiple men in dark clothing engage in close physical combat on the staircase: one is thrown backward over the railing while others grapple and strike.
A man is struck or pushed violently against the wooden wall/railing, with motion blur indicating rapid impact and struggle.
Intense melee continues on the stairs: figures collide, one is knocked down, debris flies, and blood spatter appears on the wall in frame f15.
Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat on a staircase; one is struck and thrown backward down the stairs.
A person fires a handgun while airborne mid-staircase; muzzle flash is visible at frame f3 (125.5s).
A violent struggle occurs near the stair railing, with debris and motion blur indicating impact and grappling.
A person is violently thrown or falls down the stairs, landing hard on the floor; visible impact and body contortion in frames f10–f13.
A prone individual lies motionless on the floor after being thrown; another figure looms over them, suggesting continued aggression toward a helpless victim.

A man in a black leather jacket is engaged in a violent physical confrontation on a staircase, throwing an opponent down multiple flights; motion blur and body positions indicate active mutual combat.

After being thrown down the stairs, a person lies motionless on the checkered floor while another figure looms over them; the victim appears incapacitated and helpless, consistent with post-combat abuse.
A man kneels beside a prone figure, gripping their head/neck area in a manner suggesting continued physical control or assault; facial tension and posture indicate ongoing struggle or subduing.
